changelog: Spoken punctuation gains path / code symbols: say "backslash" / "pipe symbol" / "vertical bar" / "backtick" (or "ব্যাকস্ল্যাশ" / "পাইপ চিহ্ন" / "ব্যাকটিক") while dictating in WhatsApp/Messenger and a Windows path or code snippet writes itself ("C colon backslash users backslash samir" -> "C:\users\samir", "ls pipe symbol grep" -> "ls | grep") — the last three ASCII punctuation marks the set did not cover.
